messages:
Nora: Heads-up -- copy review for the "Start private deployment" confirmation modal. Current header is 'Start private deployment' and body is 'Are you sure you want to start?' Feels vague about consequences (network, access, expected downtime).

Hector: Good call. Private deployments can imply infra work and network changes. Users should know if control plane or data plane traffic will change and whether there will be a brief routing flapping.

Iris: Draft suggestion: header 'Start private deployment' body 'Starting a private deployment will provision resources in your VPC. New traffic will route to the private instance; there may be a short period of increased latency during DNS propagation.' Primary CTA: 'Start deployment' Secondary: 'Cancel'

Nora: I like the clarity. Two nits: 1) avoid jargon like 'DNS propagation' for non-SRE users, 2) call out security note if key material is uploaded.

Hector: Replace DNS line with 'brief traffic routing changes may occur' and add a single sentence: 'Key material will be stored in your configured KMS/HSM.' Keep it one sentence if possible.

Iris: New compact copy proposal: "Starting a private deployment will provision resources in your VPC. New traffic will be routed to the private instance; brief routing changes may occur. Key material is stored in your configured KMS."

DesignBot: Accessibility + tone checks: sentences are a bit long; break into two shorter sentences for screen readers. Also ensure the modal has aria-describedby linking to the explanatory text. CTA labels OK. For localization, avoid contractions and ambiguous words.

Legal: Quick flag: please add a link to the privacy/security doc for customers handling regulated data. Suggest appending: 'See security docs' as a tertiary inline link.

Nora: Updated final strings for the component spec: Header: "Start private deployment" Body line1: "This will provision resources in your VPC and route new traffic to the private instance." Body line2: "Brief routing changes may occur. Key material will be stored in your configured KMS." Primary CTA: "Start deployment" Secondary CTA: "Cancel" Inline link: "Security docs" -> /docs/security/private-deployments

Hector: +1. UX nit: make the 'Start deployment' button yellow/destructive? it's not destructive but it's significant. Maybe use a high-visibility primary style but not red.

Iris: I'll update Figma and add the aria-describedby and link notes in the component spec. I'll open a copy PR and tag @legal for the link content.

Nora: Thanks team! :thumbsup:
